cookies.name: scoutHoursBar (browser storage)
cookies.why: Remembers that the visitor closed the hours or closure notice bar, so it stays closed on other pages. It holds only the notice's ID.
cookies.lasts: Until the browser tab is closed

notes: When Scout Analytics is on, closing the notice is also passed to it as a click, with the notice's wording. Scout Analytics lists what it does with that.
